data.one_liner: Abstract base classes and widgets for implementing BLoC pattern with pagination, items, and forms.
data.what_it_does: Provides abstract base classes and ready-to-use widgets for common flutter_bloc use cases including paginated lists, single items, and forms with validation. It standardizes data flow with features like cache-first strategies, snapshot/revert states, and event bus integration.
use_when: You are using flutter_bloc and want to reduce boilerplate for paginated lists, detail items, and validated forms
You need built-in cache-first data loading strategies with local or remote fallback
You want standardized UI widgets that automatically handle loading, error, and empty states for lists and forms
avoid_when: You prefer Riverpod or Provider for state management
You need completely custom state architectures that do not fit the list/item/form abstraction pattern
strengths: Eliminates boilerplate for common BLoC patterns like pagination and forms
Includes ready-to-use UI builder widgets with built-in state handling
Supports cache-first strategies and snapshot/revert state patterns out of the box
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to flutter_bloc and specific package base classes
Opinionated structure may feel restrictive for highly customized data flows

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard BLoC state management without the opinionated abstractions and built-in widget builders provided by this package.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer building your own custom state classes and UI integration widgets directly on top of core flutter_bloc primitives.
